notes: Margin 0.01 nDCG@10 (absolute, per group): the smallest change treated as meaningful in BEIR/MIRACL-style reporting, about 1-1.5% relative at today's 0.76 (scifact) and 0.99 (de) and about a tenth of the lexical->hybrid gaps measured on 2026-11-02 (+0.10 scifact, +0.20 de). alpha 0.05 two-sided, Holm over the collection's groups. Judgments are official and fixed: an unjudged document counts as non-relevant and the unjudged share is reported as information only; the 0.10 unjudged threshold (more than 1 in 10 top-10 slots unjudged in only one arm sends the pairs to judgment) applies only to collections with pooled judgments.
